messages:
jenna: heads up, deploybot blocked the staging publish for service-payments, saying "tag shadowing detected" across repos and refusing to proceed. I'm seeing the same tag in payments-staging and payments-canary pointing at different digests.
akash: ugh. can you paste the deploybot log line?
jenna: here: `deploybot: publish_reject reason=shadowed-tag existing_repo=payments-canary existing_digest=sha256:aa11... attempted_repo=payments-staging attempted_digest=sha256:bb22... provenance_check=fail`
leo: looks like a tag aliasing race during the parallel CI push. CI probably repushed the canary digest after the staging job read a stale tag.
akash: how many images are involved? is canary already promoted to prod anywhere?
jenna: only staging & canary for this build id. no prod flips yet. release-bot: NOTE: staging publish halted; tag collision policy: block until human review.
release-manager: @jenna @akash ok — do we want to retag staging to a new ephemeral tag and republish, or pin staging to the existing digest and schedule a republish in the next change window?
leo: retag-and-republish is fastest but loses the original tag name, might confuse QA. pin-to-digest preserves QA context and we can republish with the canonical tag in the maintenance window.
akash: agree with pin-to-digest. we should also add a short note in release notes and mark the canary/build id as quarantined until we verify provenance.
jenna: commands I ran: ```
# show tag digests
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name payments-staging --image-ids imageTag=staging --query 'images[].imageId.imageDigest' --output text
# show canary
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name payments-canary --image-ids imageTag=canary --query 'images[].imageId.imageDigest' --output text
```
leo: thanks. can you run `cosign verify --output=json` on both digests and paste the result? we need to confirm attestation mismatch vs legit repush.
jenna: pasted cosign output to the thread: canary digest has a valid attestation for buildid=2026-03-20-17, staging digest has a different buildid and no attestation.
release-manager: decision: pin staging route to digest `sha256:bb22...` (the staging-specific digest) so the deploybot will allow the current staging deploy. create a follow-up ticket to: (1) republish canonical tag to both repos with unified digest, (2) update publish CI to serialize tag writes for payments, (3) add deploybot mitigation to retry with ephemeral tags if shadow detected.
akash: I'll open the ticket and schedule the republish in the 2hr change window at 22:00 UTC tonight. Tagging note for release notes: "staging image temporarily pinned to digest due to cross-repo tag collision; no prod impact."
jenna: applying pin now: `deployctl pin-image --repo payments-staging --tag staging --digest sha256:bb22... --reason "shadowing block"`
release-bot: ACTION: pinned payments-staging:staging -> sha256:bb22... by jenna.
leo: once republish completes, let's run a small canary (10 req/s) to ensure no behavioral regressions before unpinning.
release-manager: nice. add a one-line changelog that the consolidation republish happened and include the buildids/digests. I'll notify QA and oncall about the planned republish. :thumbsup:
jenna: thanks — keeping thread open until republish done. will post status under this thread.
release-bot: REMINDER scheduled republish ticket #RELEASE-1987 at 22:00 UTC.
jenna: update: republish completed at 22:12 UTC, both repos now point to digest sha256:cc33... (new unified image). cosign verify shows attestation for buildid=2026-03-20-18.
leo: ran canary smoke tests, 0 errors over 5 minutes at 10rps.
akash: unpinning staging and unblocking deploybot: `deployctl unpin-image --repo payments-staging --tag staging`
release-bot: UNPIN: payments-staging:staging unpinned by akash. staging publish allowed.
release-manager: closing action items: 1) CI serialization (akash), 2) deploybot retry/ephemeral fallthrough (leo), 3) release note update (jenna). Thanks all. :tada:
